# period start

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/periodStart>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

The instant at which a named period begins. Functional nature removed because the property chain below makes [`periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) non-simple, and OWL 2 DL forbids non-simple properties in functional axioms ([Principle 8](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-8)). Closed-world single-valuedness lives in SHACL (NamedPeriodShape).
